Name: Shingle beach
Description: Waves on a shingle beach (ShoreSpec.Shingle, ShoreSynth): plunging at its foot, the backwash dragging the pebbles down. Its box is the stretch of edge it stands for: X its length along the edge, Z the fetch, how far the water reaches straight out from it; turn the entity so its +Z faces the water. Silent in a calm. Not a recording and not a loop.
